digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center transport retry/error handling
propositions: Jira Data Center rate-limit 429 responses are not honoured; a 429 propagates as a hard failure aborting the in-flight read or mutation.
The retry policy must honour a present Retry-After header with up to 20% jitter applied first then clamped to MAX_BACKOFF_S, treating absent headers as normal.

429 retry must be scoped to idempotent reads via a per-call opt-in defaulting off, because _with_connection_retry fronts all call sites including create_issue and retrying mutations would reintroduce duplicate issues.
When the 429 retry cap is exhausted the code must raise BackendHTTPError(code=429), never leak the raw JIRAError past the adapter boundary.
The retry/error cluster (including TlsVerificationError) must be extracted from transport.py into adapters/jira_datacenter/retry.py because the file is at the locked 800-LOC cap.
The parent ticket is decomposed into child S1 (behaviour-preserving extraction) and child S2 (429 policy), with S2 depending_on S1 as a recorded link.
